# Function order for the release binary's text (#7260): read by scripts/link-order/link.py at link
# time, regenerated by scripts/link-order/generate.py (see its docstring). Demangled names, no crate
# hashes; a name the build does not define is skipped. Lines starting with `#` are comments.
# Generated 2026-11-24 from a9da4e814 (#7894) by `generate.py linux` on a Ryzen 9 7950X (Linux, valgrind 3.18):
# the startup block in first-execution order, the functions the 1 MB rows run, then what only the
# 10 MB rows run (#7412). Then `generate.py macos` on an Apple M4 Pro added 38 names at the end of
# the startup block: every NEON / aarch64 / Apple-only function that binary defines, called or not.
# That pass is not a sample of what runs (#7826).
# The list goes stale as functions are renamed: regenerate it last before a release
# (docs/guides/release.md). `generate.py stale` fails CI's perf-guard job when more than 5% of
# these names no longer resolve (#7894).
